text:
Olivia: AM async check-in: finished policy scan for prod accounts — found 3 buckets with public-read, filed tickets. KMS rotation dry-run scheduled for 10:30 PT; will report results. Blocker: need iam:PassRole for rotation-lambda to run revocation smoke tests. Also pinging PR #4382 for IAM cleanup review. TL;DR: audits mostly ok, one perms blocker.

Devin: thanks — can you paste the bucket names? I'll triage access. Also what's the PR link?

Olivia: Buckets: prod-logs-arch, metrics-export, redwood-backups. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4382 — small change removing a wildcard from an assumed-role policy.

Sam: @Olivia I can take the PR. re iam:PassRole — who owns rotation-lambda role? @Lee?

Lee: I own rotation-lambda. Perms look scoped; added iam:PassRole for the CI runner in staging. For prod we need infra approval, opening INFRA-9123 now. Dry-run in staging succeeded. Logs: ```aws kms rotate-key --key-id alias/redwood_prod --dry-run``` returned OK :white_check_mark:.

Jordan: Heads up — vuln scanner flagged dependency `fast-serializer` v1.8.2 (high). Opened SEC-324. Impact: token serialization path in metrics pipeline. Mitigation: pin to v1.8.1 and run integration tests, then canary. Who can do the pin+canary today?

Olivia: I can pin in metrics-export service and run canary tonight. Will post canary link and results.

Devin: I'll help with canary monitoring. For the public S3 buckets, quick mitigation: apply block-public-acls and add bucket policy to deny public. I'll open a quick infra PR and @infra-team.

Sam: Reviewed #4382 — left one nit about coverage. @Olivia can you add a unit test for the assume-role fallback?

Olivia: Will add the test by EOD. Also compliance requested a CSV of rotated keys in the last 30d — @Lee can you export KMS rotation events? If not I can pull via CloudTrail.

Lee: Can export and attach to SEC-324. ETA 14:00 PT.

sec-bot: Automated report: weekly audit job completed. Findings summary: 3 public buckets, 1 high vuln (fast-serializer), 2 medium IAM findings. Runbook: https://internal.redwood.dev/runbooks/audit-response. :robot_face:

Jordan: Thanks — I'll pick up SEC-324 triage and coordinate the metrics canary. Anything else blocking folks?

Olivia: No other blockers. Quick ask: can everyone try to clear PRs in eng-security backlog? We have ~6 waiting and exec wants a short turnaround. :pray:

Devin: :thumbsup: will scan the backlog after this standup.
